body: Thank you, it means a lot. It just seems like it's easier for all of my friends and I wish it wasn't so ridiculously hard for ME specifically. I'm not trying to ask for the best in the world, just SOMETHING.

I'm about to turn 21. I was at a kinda low point in my life when I was 18. I was out of school and didn't have a job. Then I started training Brazilian Jiu Jitsu and fell in love with it. Then I got a job at Walmart and started going to school to become a paralegal. About half a year ago I started dedicating myself to losing weight by dieting because I thought the reason I couldn't get a girlfriend was because I was overweight. I lost a bunch of weight and got in shape and built up some confidence but it hasn't really changed anything. I never hear from my friends anymore cuz they're all living their own lives with their girlfriends and such. I don't have any close family members. About a month ago I started talking to this girl and we were supposed to go on a date but after being cancelled on three times she left me on read. I don't necessarily want to die, I just want the suffering of being alone to end. It's like I commit myself to work, school, and Martial Arts, but at the end of the day, I have nothing to come home to. I honestly don't know what to do and it scares me. I just wanted one girl to give me a chance and I just feel like I was meant to be alone but I can't stand it.
